parameters.name: spill_size
parameters.description:
The threshold between Small and Large spill sizes is
Liquids: 55 gallons (208 liters) and Solids: 60 Pounds (27 kilograms).

parameters.name: show_fire
parameters.description: Add fire isolation zones to results if available.

parameters.name: wind_direction
parameters.description: Wind direction angle (0 to 359.9). North: 0, East: 90, South: 180, West: 270.

parameters.name: show_bleve
parameters.description: Show BLEVE Isolation Zone for applicable materials.

parameters.name: container_capacity
parameters.description: BLEVE Container Capacity in liters for applicable materials.

parameters.name: wind_speed
parameters.description: Wind speed at time of spill. Low: Under 6 mph (10 kph), Moderate: Between 6-12 mph (10-20 kph), High: Over 12 mph.

parameters.name: transport_container
choiceList: Multiple small cyclinders or single ton container

parameters.name: append
parameters.description: When enabled the output ERG Zones will be appended to an existing feature layer.

parameters.name: analysisid
parameters.description: An ID written to the output ERG Zones to help identify this run of the analysis.
